messages:
nina_marketing: quick sync 0 seeing another blip where webinar leads sit unassigned 3-7m. looks like enrichment 202 + rr retries causing churn. want a short, shipable cooldown plan.

carl_salesops: confirmed. pattern = hubspot deferred -> rr retries -> claim race across geo pools. conversion impact when >2m.

evan_eng: propose minimal safe plan: set ENRICH_HOLD when webhook returns 202 with ttl=120s. while ENRICH_HOLD true: block pool hops, allow only one claim attempt, dedupe claims within 25s. after ttl, route to overflow.

tara_sdr: for high-intent webinar leads can we also send an automatic Slack digest if unassigned >90s so SDRs can snap-rescue? short-term manual safety.

hubspot-integ: note: HubSpot may resend events; add idempotency by eventId+externalId. webhooks should return 202 when queued, 200 when processed.

evan_eng: eng action items i can take today:
- add ENRICH_HOLD flag + TTL=120s (PR)
- rr: implement claim dedupe window 25s + single-retry semantics (PR)
- expose metrics: enrich_hold_count, duplicate_claim_rate (Prom)

nina_marketing: ops/workflow tasks:
- tara: build a minimal Slack/email digest for unassigned webinar leads >90s
- carl: update handoff playbook with exact logs to inspect (rr.claim_id, webhook.eventId) and escalation thresholds: overflow>20 in 10m -> page oncall

ci-bot: canary deploy planned: 10% traffic for 2h -> monitor median_time_to_assign and duplicate_claim_rate.

evan_eng: deploying to staging now, will enable canary after quick integ tests.

tara_sdr: digest template drafted; will pilot tonight and hand off notes in the doc.

nina_marketing: good. target: ship minimal flags + digest today, monitor through weekend, reconvene Monday with metrics. tagging follow-ups: @evan_eng (eng PRs), @carl_salesops (playbook + alerts), @tara_sdr (digest). :thumbsup:

ci-bot: staging build passed: feature/enrich-hold (build 20260401-09). canary toggle ready.

evan_eng: note in PR: dedupe window 25s, enrich_hold ttl 120s, fallback -> overflow after ttl. will open PR link in a minute.

nina_marketing: closing thread once PRs merged and canary reports look good. thanks all.
